   The goal is to improve structure, reduce duplication, and improve code quality without changing behavior.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Android TV app using Leanback library (BrowseFragment, PlaybackFragment)
   - ExoPlayer for video playback with custom glue classes
   - MVP architecture: Presenters, Views, Controllers
   - RxJava2 for async operations (Disposable, Observable)
   - Flag-then-break loop → early-return refactoring
   - Overload delegation (2-arg calls the 4-arg with defaults)
   - Dead method removal (methods only referenced in commented-out code)
   - Split guard merging (two sequential `if(!x) return; if(!y) return;` → one)
   - Helper extraction for repeated 3-4 line blocks
   - Intermediate variable elimination (`Type x = method(); return x;` → `return method()`)
   - Redundant null ternary simplification after guarded non-null
   - Duplicate dead code removal (same condition appearing twice)
   - Git commits with attribution: `Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>`

3. Files and Code Sections:

   **Round 2 (committed as `8d3303817`):**

   - `PlayerUIController.java` — extracted `onRatingClicked()` shared by `onDislikeClicked`/`onLikeClicked`:
     ```java
     private void onDislikeClicked(int buttonState) {
         onRatingClicked(buttonState, R.id.action_thumbs_down,
                 mMediaItemService::setDislikeObserve, mMediaItemService::removeDislikeObserve);
     }
     private void onLikeClicked(int buttonState) {
         onRatingClicked(buttonState, R.id.action_thumbs_up,
                 mMediaItemService::setLikeObserve, mMediaItemService::removeLikeObserve);
     }
     private void onRatingClicked(int buttonState, int buttonId,
             MediaItemObservable setObservable, MediaItemObservable removeObservable) {
         if (getPlayer() == null) return;
         boolean rated = buttonState == PlayerUI.BUTTON_ON;
         getPlayer().setButtonState(buttonId, !rated ? PlayerUI.BUTTON_ON : PlayerUI.BUTTON_OFF);
         if (!mIsMetadataLoaded) { MessageHelpers.showMessage(...); return; }
         if (!YouTubeSignInService.instance().isSigned()) {
             getPlayer().setButtonState(buttonId, PlayerUI.BUTTON_OFF);
             MessageHelpers.showMessage(...); return;
         }
         callMediaItemObservable(!rated ? setObservable : removeObservable);
     }
     ```

   - `VideoPlayerGlue.java` — extracted `addButtonIfEnabled()` helpers (two overloads) to collapse ~27 repetitive 3-line if-blocks
   - `VideoMenuPresenter.java` — merged `prepareAndShowDialogSigned/Unsigned` into `prepareAndShowDialog(boolean isAuthenticated)`
   - `SuggestionsController.java` — extracted `updateChapterFocus(boolean)` from `onControlsShown`/`onSeekEnd`
   - `VideoStateController.java` — cached `getTempVideoFormat()` to avoid double-call in `restoreVideoFormat()`

     ```java
     private void scheduleIfEngineReady(Runnable action, int delayMs) {
         if (getPlayer() != null && getPlayer().isEngineInitialized()) {
             Utils.postDelayed(action, delayMs);
         }
     }
     private void reloadVideo(int delayMs) {
         Log.d(TAG, "Reloading the video...");
         scheduleIfEngineReady(mReloadVideo, delayMs);
     }
     private void loadNextVideo(int delayMs) {
         Log.d(TAG, "Starting the next video...");
         scheduleIfEngineReady(mLoadNext, delayMs);
     }
     ```
   - `VideoStateController.java`:
     - `isMusicVideo()`: `Video item = getVideo(); return item != null && item.belongsToMusic();`
     - `onSpeedClicked()`: `getStateService().getByVideoId(getVideo().videoId)` (was redundant null ternary)
   - `PlayerUIController.java`: removed unused `flipEnabled` variable in `onFlip()`
   - `AppDialogUtil.java`: dropped redundant inner `if (video.videoId != null)` in share-embed and share-QR lambdas

   **Round 4 (committed as `52007cbc8`):**

     - `convertToFullVideoUrl`, `convertToEmbedVideoUrl`, `convertToFullChannelUrl`, `convertToPlaylistUrl` — each collapsed to: `return Uri.parse(String.format(...))`

     - `setPlaylistAddButtonState()`: set `BUTTON_ON` + return on match, set `BUTTON_OFF` after loop (removes `isSelected` variable)
